summary: Created 15 Bun containment tests across MCP resources, harness wiki/skills, and the proposed shared contained reader. Current source is intentionally RED at 2 pass / 13 fail: external links and replaced roots are not fail-closed, linked skill discovery is incomplete, lexical containment re-roots after owner replacement, and src/lib/contained-read.ts is not yet present.
summary_markdown: TEST_CASE_SPECS: T5-test-case-specs.json defines 15 RED scenarios and the proposed src/lib/contained-read.ts API. Run the focused command in T5-red-evidence.md; no production edits were made.

acceptance.criterion: Ordinary file and internal link chain return same bytes inside narrow owner root.
acceptance.evidence: MCP and harness happy-path tests cover direct files plus internal file/directory links; two current happy paths pass, while the linked discovery cases remain RED until implementation follows links safely.

acceptance.criterion: External/sibling/root-replacement links and nonfiles/unreadable paths cannot disclose synthetic sentinel or unsafe target names.
acceptance.evidence: MCP and harness tests use temporary roots, external sentinel symlinks, replaced owner roots, and leak-safe structured errors; current external/root-replacement tests fail as intended.

acceptance.criterion: MCP resource listing and harness wiki/skills discovery/direct reads observe the same containment rules; cycles are bounded.
acceptance.evidence: Resource listing tests require internal aliases, cycle bounding, and external omission; harness tests require equivalent wiki reads, linked skill discovery, and loadSkill parity.

acceptance.criterion: Race test verifies descriptor/identity protection or explicit capability refusal; no unsupported full TOCTOU claim.
acceptance.evidence: Shared-reader specs define an injectable beforeOpen replacement fixture, typed CONTAINED_READ_UNAVAILABLE capability refusal, regular-file and max-byte checks, and explicitly avoid claiming pathname realpath/readFile race safety.
